listeners.doc: Connects to a Solace PubSub+ broker and dispatches each delivered message to the attached service.

serviceTypes.doc: Consumes messages delivered from the queue or topic named in @solace:ServiceConfig.

options.name: onMessage
options.doc: Invoked once per message delivered from the queue or topic named in @solace:ServiceConfig. Declare a narrower payload type to project the message payload, see the messagePayload data-binding rule.

params.name: message
params.doc: The delivered message. Declare a narrower type to project the payload, see the messagePayload data-binding rule.

params.name: caller
params.doc: Handle for explicit acknowledgement and transaction control. Needed only when the service's ackMode is CLIENT_ACK (for caller->ack/caller->nack) or the listener's connection is transacted (for caller->commit/caller->rollback).

options.name: onError
options.doc: Invoked when a delivered message cannot be dispatched to onMessage, most commonly because its payload fails to bind to a declared narrowed payload type.

rules.message: A Solace service needs its subscription from exactly one source: @solace:ServiceConfig { queueName } for a queue or @solace:ServiceConfig { topicName } for a topic.
